title: Blackcurrant Watercolor Cliparts PNG SVG
author: CozyNest Studio
description:
🌿 Celebrate the rich elegance of blackcurrants with this blackcurrant watercolor clipart collection featuring botanical branches, flowering stems, berry studies, lush foliage, harvest arrangements, homemade preserves, classic European desserts, refreshing beverages, and cozy breakfast favorites. Created in a premium modern watercolor style with softly rounded organic shapes, rich purple-black berries, fresh green leaves, and delicate painterly gradients, this collection is perfect for both botanical and culinary-inspired creative projects.
✨ Perfect for:
• Print on Demand products
• Stickers and sticker sheets
• Scrapbooking projects
• Journals and planners
• Recipe books and cards
• Greeting cards and invitations
• Food branding and packaging
• Farmers market designs
• Botanical stationery
• Digital and printable crafts
🍇 What’s included:
– 20 high-quality illustrations
– Transparent background
– High resolution – 300 DPI (perfect for print & digital use)
– 20 PNG files (transparent background)
– 20 SVG files
🌿 Included illustrations:
blackcurrant branch, whole and cut blackcurrant study, blackcurrant blossom branch, blackcurrant harvest arrangement, blackcurrant life cycle, blackcurrant leaves study, blackcurrant basket, blackcurrant botanical bouquet, blackcurrant shrub branch, blackcurrant botanical cluster, blackcurrant jelly jar, blackcurrant Swiss roll, blackcurrant pavlova, blackcurrant sorbet, blackcurrant crumble bars, blackcurrant cordial, blackcurrant herbal tea, blackcurrant yogurt parfait, blackcurrant ice cream, blackcurrant syrup bottle.
🍇 Inspired by summer blackcurrant harvests, cottage gardens, European bakeries, homemade fruit preserves, herbal tea traditions, countryside kitchens, seasonal desserts, fresh breakfast tables, botanical illustration, farm-to-table living, and elegant watercolor artwork. These versatile illustrations bring together the natural beauty of blackcurrants with cozy culinary favorites, making them ideal for creating refined seasonal designs, recipe projects, stationery, packaging, and handmade gifts.
